answer: Because the oasis cliff is fixed at deposit and logged in the jade ledger, the yarrow audit publishes how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 21 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. The deposit is 50 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
